Real Safari 26.2 (macOS): H1 final/fallback re-wraps 16 -> 0 of 70 views (10 DC routes x 7 widths), final H1 lines = Chromium 70/70; Playwright WebKit delayed swap: views above 0.01 8 -> 0, max shift 61 -> 1px; Chromium and Firefox renders identical pre/post. Closure recommended (GATE_4_POST_B4_REMEDIATION.md); iOS Safari not tested (E1). DEC-044: CLOSED for the verified scope (real Safari 26.2 macOS + Playwright WebKit; 10 DC routes; 320-1440px). Not verified on iOS Safari / iPhone / iPad (E1). Does not close OBS-18

observations_not_fingerprinted.title: Playwright Firefox paints the Direction C display roles in Arial Narrow while the display face is still loading: the calibrated local() fallback faces stay 'unloaded', so a late face re-wraps H1s (delayed-face sweep: 27 of 70 views shift, 19 above an approximate 0.01, max approx 0.041; CTA moves up to 157px). With the face blocked for good, the calibrated fallback is used and matches (0 re-wraps)

observations_not_fingerprinted.status: Pre-existing, identical before and after DEC-043; Firefox engine proxy only (no real Firefox in this environment): RESEARCH REQUIRED in a real Firefox release. Not fixed (fallback strategy is outside DEC-043); owner decision. DEC-044 diagnostic: classification D. UNVERIFIED (no real Firefox available). Cause identified in Gecko source: a later @font-face (the local() calibrated fallback) is not loaded while an earlier one (dcDisplay) is loading, so the stack falls to Arial Narrow; present in Firefox 115/128 ESR and the release revision behind Playwright's build; Playwright patches no font code; unchanged without request interception. Playwright Firefox: late face deterministic (27/70 views, 19 > approx 0.01, max approx 0.041); normal loopback loads paint Arial Narrow for 12-53 ms in about half of runs; runtime-only priming of the calibrated faces removes every re-wrap (0/70). Not fixed; next step real-Firefox verification (owner decision). DEC-045: CONFIRMED in official Firefox 157.0.1 (release); recommended classification A (confirmed real-Firefox defect). Late face deterministic: 24/63 views on all DC routes change H1 lines, max approx 0.041 (geometric, not native CLS), visible CTA moves up to 78px; normal cold loopback loads paint the pending face in 16/61 (about 16 ms), H1 re-wraps in 6 views. Playwright Firefox representative; Chromium unaffected. Correction to DEC-044: out-of-flow priming is unreliable; in-flow hidden priming spans remove every H1 re-wrap (0) with identical accessibility tree/Tab order and no JavaScript. Not fixed; correction needs a separate owner decision DEC-046: CORRECTED ON THE BRANCH (3b333c4): DcPage renders four hidden, zero-height, aria-hidden, in-flow span.dc-font-prime (one per calibrated display fallback; glyph from ::before). Official Firefox 157.0.1, 10 DC routes x 7 widths x 0/300/2500 ms: H1 line changes 10/25/25 views -> 0/0/0 (672 runs); calibrated face painted while pending; Playwright Firefox the same; Chromium, WebKit, real Safari 26.2 unchanged; a11y tree/Tab order/text identical; 0 hydration errors; works without JavaScript. CLOSURE RECOMMENDED, NOT RECORDED (owner decision). DEC-047 (2026-10-10): CLOSED for the verified scope (official Firefox 157.0.1 and Playwright Firefox 153 on macOS; the 10 Direction C routes; 320-1440 px; loopback, cold cache) after re-verification of the 3b333c4 evidence; still fixed on the OBS-19 build 46785af (official Firefox, display face held 2.5 s: 0 H1 line changes, 0 display-caused moves).

observations_not_fingerprinted.status: OPEN. DEC-046 diagnostic: classification A recommended (confirmed defect requiring remediation); not fixed. Site-wide. Real Firefox 157.0.1: late Manrope paragraph/CTA moves up to 56/54 px; normal cold first visits pending state painted in ~20% of loads, moves <= 32 px. Chromium: native layout-shift up to 0.10-0.12 when Manrope is late (consent banner +23 px at 430), none on normal first visits. Runtime-only in-flow priming of "Manrope Fallback" fixes mechanism 1 only. Remediation proposal (priming + calibrated weight-specific fallbacks) awaits a separate owner decision. DEC-047 (2026-10-11): PARTIALLY REMEDIATED ON THE BRANCH (46785af), STILL OPEN. Mechanism A RESOLVED: root-layout in-flow primes (2 spans) + weight-specific calibrated 'Manrope Fallback' (Arial 100-500 at 103.25%, Arial Bold 600-900 at 99%; next/font adjustFontFallback off): official Firefox paints the calibrated face, never system-ui, in every pending run (JS on and off). Mechanism B MITIGATED, NOT REMOVED: consent banner height change 23px (11 views) -> 0; button re-wraps 28 -> 0; Chromium late-Manrope native layout-shift max 0.1215 -> 0.049, views > 0.01 23 -> 13, 3 views worse (/blog); weight-400 re-wraps about 3% of regular-weight element-views in every engine, essentially unchanged; paragraph moves up to 52px and button moves up to 29px remain when Manrope arrives late; Firefox normal loads: moves in 3 of 84 views (<= 37px). Loaded-state change: U+2192 arrows (not in Manrope's latin subset) now drawn by the new faces (bold arrows 0.71px narrower). Recommended classification: OPEN, residual late-font only; owner decision on the residual. OBS-19 final disposition assessment (2026-10-11, assessment only, no decision): STILL OPEN, owner decision pending. Realistic synthetic profiles: Chromium, WebKit, real Safari 26.2 Manrope ready at first paint in every run; Firefox fallback painted 13-49 ms after first paint on some loads (one above-the-fold CTA case, /ai-seo 430, 27px). /blog 'worse' = empty plain-build artefact (fixture: current <= pre). Official Firefox /contact pairs now verified (system-ui -> calibrated, 0px). font-display:optional and arrow-only faces tested, not adopted. Recommended, not decided: close for Manrope with documented exception; keep swap; accept arrow difference; register Bricolage late arrival separately (proposed OBS-20). See GATE_4_OBS19_FINAL_DISPOSITION.md. DEC-048 (2026-10-11, owner): CLOSED for the Manrope fallback-font remediation WITH A DOCUMENTED RESIDUAL EXCEPTION (not an unconditional pass): with Manrope held 2.5 s, text still reflows (about 3% of regular-weight elements) and above-the-fold paragraphs/CTAs move up to about 29px, Chromium layout shift up to 0.049; banner height and button wrapping stable. Under the tested realistic synthetic profiles the Manrope impact was limited, with one intermittent Firefox above-the-fold CTA movement (/ai-seo 430, 27px). Calibrated fallback (46785af) retained; font-display: swap retained (optional not adopted); U+2192 arrow difference accepted (arrow correction not adopted). The Bricolage part of this entry's title is tracked separately as OBS-20. Not verified: real devices, Windows/Linux, field data. Does not waive real-device testing, accessibility requirements or production release gates.
